styleAnswer.evidence: The sacks heap has about 5 lightness steps: highlight, light, mid and dark sack faces, plus darker tied tops and fold shadows. Each sack is shaded separately, so it avoids the flat 'body plus outline' look. The measured facts back this up: 9 visible tones per tile, which matches prop-hedge (9) and is below prop-well-roofed (20) and prop-stall-cheese (17). Near-flat coverage is 0%, so no large flat fills. Dark edge pixels are 43% near-neutral, almost the same as prop-bench-wood (44%) and prop-well-roofed (33%). Texture is moderate: fold lines and speckle on the sacks, but no fine grain like the stall or well. A compact, low-detail pile of this kind is acceptable next to the hedge and bench references without looking thinner or flatter.
